title: DeepIM: Deep Iterative Matching for 6D Pose Estimation
input: RGB + object region/masks + intrinsics + rendered model + initial 6D pose
object_prior: Known renderable metric 3D model and object identity; initial pose required; unseen-object refinement studied
training_requirement: Supervised relative-pose refinement with rendered/observed pairs and iterative training; generalization depends on training protocol
output: Refined object-to-camera R,t; not global detection
